summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill focused on environment-specific Maven build configuration using profiles and toolchains. It does not semantically overlap with peer candidates (project initialization, lifecycle execution, reproducible builds) or existing skills (JavaScript bundle analysis, static asset serving). The candidate addresses a specific workflow need: generating environment-specific artifacts through profile activation and toolchain mapping. No existing skill covers this capability, and peer candidates address different stages (initialization, generic lifecycle, reproducibility) rather than environment-specific customization.
